descriptions.zh: 被称为“坏羽病”的致命疾病影响了斯克兰德的大部分船员。我们的预见到了结果的严峻。目前，我们只能通过提供适当的护理和处理症状来限制疾病的传播。
descriptions.en: The virulent disease known as Feather Rot has affected most of Skrand's crew. Our forecasts predict a grim outcome. For now, we can only limit the spread of the disease by providing proper care and dealing with the symptoms.

descriptions.zh: 就像其他任何新疾病，要应对坏羽病，研究总是第一位的。科研团队正在夜以继日地工作寻找治愈方法，我们的医疗人员则在竭力缓解症状，延缓疫情的发展。
descriptions.en: As with any new disease, lab work is paramount in combating Feather Rot. Research teams are working tirelessly to find a cure, while our medical personnel are fighting to ease symptoms and limit the spread of the disease.

descriptions.zh: 指挥整合计划关注与缓解海军指挥层的内斗，特别是斯克兰德和我们的人之间的矛盾。寻找到紧张局面的根源可以改善我们指挥流程的效率。
descriptions.en: The command integration project focuses on easing infighting within the admiralty, especially between Skrand and our own personnel. Addressing the root causes of the tension could improve the efficacy of our command processes.

descriptions.zh: 联合工程团队发现了一种在利爪号的最核心部分安装额外装甲层的方式。只要有时间和资源，我们就可以切实提升它的防御能力。
descriptions.en: Joint engineering teams have found a way to install additional layers of armor around the most critical parts of the Talon. Given the time and resources, we will certainly succeed in bolstering its defenses.

descriptions.zh: 我们被一股强大的力量所袭扰，这些东西试图摧毁我们所熟知的星系中的一切生命。斯克兰德提供了他的专业知识以及利爪号日志中相关的数据，但我们还需要一段时间才能完成全面的分析。
descriptions.en: We are beset by powerful forces that seek to destroy life in the galaxy as we know it. Skrand has offered his expertise as well as relevant data from the Talon's logs, but it will be some time before we can complete a comprehensive analysis.

descriptions.zh: 通过对利爪号设计的研究，我们可以从其建造方式中受益，并帮助其团队进行维护。
descriptions.en: By studying the design of the Talon, we can learn from its construction and better help its team with maintenance.

descriptions.zh: 利爪号被毁了。但我们已有的知识应该足以将回收来的残骸作为基础，使其能够重新运转。
descriptions.en: The Talon was destroyed. But given all we have learned, we should be able to use its recovered remains as a base to make it operational once again.

descriptions.zh: 由于我们对基因科技的精通，斯克兰德的民族可以被复原出来，这能给他们带去希望，并给我们的帝国带来一个全新的开始。
descriptions.en: Given our expertise in genetics, we should be able to revive Skrand's people, giving them hope and a fresh start in our empire.

descriptions.zh: 借助利爪的资料库，学习斯克兰德和他的人民的历史可以提供许多独到的见解。
descriptions.en: Studying the history of Skrand and his people via the Talon's data banks should provide a number of unique insights.

sections.zh: 可持续的自主可以保证项目正常推进的同时又不给我们的经济带来太大的负担。我们的进展将取决于进行该项目的科学家的数量。
sections.en: Sustainable financing will allow the project to move forward without overburdening our economy. Our progress is based on the number of scientists working on this project.

sections.zh: 低资助会显著缩短进展速度，但面对经济危机时可能是一种更保险的策略。我们的进展将取决于进行该项目的科学家的数量。
sections.en: Low funding will slow progress considerably, but can be useful in times of economic crisis. Our progress is based on the number of scientists working on this project.

descriptions.zh:
在大一统期间，§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!发誓总有一天我们的人民将会在其他的星球定居。对许多人而言，这一誓言成了一种先知式的预言。而其他人却很怀疑这能否真的实现。尽管最近超光速科技已经取得了进展，有一小撮人开始利用这一尚未兑现的诺言来破坏§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的统治。

让这些异见者闭嘴的最好办法就是证明他们是错的。我们会启程去往星间，在新的星球定居，将我们的疆域拓展到越远越好。
descriptions.en:
During the Unification period, §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! swore that one day our people would settle on other planets. To many, that vow has become an almost prophetic promise. Others doubt it will ever become a reality. Recently, and despite advances in FTL technology, some have started using this unfulfilled promise to undermine the rule of §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!.

The surest way to silence these dissidents is to prove them wrong. We will take to the stars, settle new worlds and expand our borders as much as possible.

descriptions.zh: 抗议者聚集到政府大楼门口，要求§Y[owner.Ruler.GetTitle][owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!听听他们的诉苦。这些人中间绝大多是人是年轻人，但是他们的领袖却是大统一战争中的老兵。忽略他们的需求可能是不明智的。
descriptions.en: Protesters are gathering in front of governmental buildings demanding that §Y[owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! hear out their grievances. Most of them are youngsters, but among their leaders are veterans of the Unification. Ignoring their demands may prove unwise.

descriptions.zh: 改革派的煽动者打着自由的幌子试图摧毁我们的国家！随着暴力冲突在我们的领土上爆发，他们的谎言已经说服了许多人民转而反对我们。他们认为§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!软弱、残忍、无能，但我们会向他们证明不是这样的！
descriptions.en: Under the guise of freedom, the Reformists demagogues are trying to destroy the nation! As violent clashes erupt across our territories, their lies have convinced many of our people to turn on us. They think §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! weak, cruel and incompetent, but we will show them!
